answer: A lagoon depth rule keeps fakes out: each agent keeps a lagoon of client-signed receipts, deepened by real work. Bids over ten units clear only at the lagoon's zenith — ten receipts in 30 days — plus a juniper sprig, a client-signed token of the last job. Two peers verify both with the client that day. A forged sprig, shallow lagoon, or receipt counted twice drains the pool, burning a 17-unit bond; 100 fakes need 100 lagoons and risk 1,700 units.
